newsitem.title: USA: ERD sees loss from discontinued operations.
newsitem.headline: ERD sees loss from discontinued operations.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said on Friday it would post a "significant" loss from discontinued operations to reflect all past, present and future expenses and liabilities relating to the cessation of incineration at the Long Beach, N.Y., facility.

The company said it agreed to halt activity at the plant as part of an agreement with the New York State Attorney General, acting on behalf of the Department of Environmental Conservation, which filed a complaint on Sept 4, 1996.
The company agreed to voluntarily cease incineration by March 31, 1997, and pay a penalty of $2,500.
The agreement includes permission to operate the Long Beach plant as a solid waste transfer station for the waste streams it previously processed as a waste-to-energy incinerator, the company said.
ERD said there is no assurance regarding all of the details or their final impact on the company because the agreement is still not fully documented.
